entry.description: Search for the CDATA end marker ordinally in `XmlLayout` and `XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J`. Text with ignorable characters, or a combining mark after the marker, now stays intact in its event in every culture (ANT-2026-2PJSIJWL, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
